payload.selection_rationale: Composed by the engine from 2 minor defects a failing test proves (SC-080, SC-081). Each names the defect and carries the test that shows it, so there was nothing for a tournament to choose between.

key_decisions.decision: SC-080: The walk rule 'the walk calls a folder gone only through SizeProbe.IsGone' still lets C# pattern-combinator spellings of the gone codes through.
key_decisions.rationale: the engine watched tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/SL005ReviewGoneCodeCaseSpellingTests.cs fail with `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter FullyQualifiedName~SL005ReviewGoneCodeCaseSpellingTests`

key_decisions.decision: SC-081: IN-m1 (minor): The walk's gone-code rule misses the C# 9 pattern-combinator spellings of the codes.
key_decisions.rationale: the engine watched tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/GoneCodePatternCombinatorSpellingTests.cs fail with `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter FullyQualifiedName~GoneCodePatternCombinatorSpellingTests`

payload.coherence_check: Each row is fixed on its own and none may undo another. A row whose test already passes is left alone, and the build says so.
